# Implementation Plan: System Integration & Environment Standardization

**Branch**: `004-system-integration` | **Date**: 2026-07-27 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/004-system-integration/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by `/speckit-plan` to consolidate the architecture decisions made in Phase 0 (Research) and Phase 1 (Design).

---

## Summary

Connect the independently built SmartFlow components (ESP32 Firmware, Android App, Firebase Cloud Backend) into a single end-to-end system. This requires migrating from the V1 `pump_system/` RTDB schema to a V2 multi-tenant `/devices/{id}/` schema, embedding Firebase Anonymous Authentication in the firmware, configuring BLE GATT for provisioning status feedback, and enforcing strict owner-based security rules in Firebase.

---

## Constitution Gate *(must pass before Phase 0)*

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. Fail Toward Pump OFF | ☑ Pass | Integration of Firebase credentials does not bias pump toward ON. Firmware safety constraints remain active. |
| II. Dry-Run Lockout | ☑ Pass | Cloud-side `shadow/desired` writes cannot bypass the local dry-run latch. |
| III. Overflow Protection | ☑ Pass | Firebase commands do not suppress overflow lockout. |
| IV. TOR Independence | ☑ Pass | Physical hardware cutouts are completely unaffected by RTDB integration. |
| V. Sensor Freshness / E-Stop | ☑ Pass | Cloud Functions/App commands cannot race with `reset_stop`. |
| VI. Backward Compatibility | ☑ **Exempt** | User clarified no live production devices exist. The old `/pump_system/` schema is safely hard-replaced by the new `/devices/` schema without migration. |

---

## Technical Context

**Modules affected**:
- [x] Firmware Master — `firmware/master_node/`
- [ ] Firmware Sensor Node — `firmware/sensor_node/`
- [x] Dashboard (Android App) — `app/` (Native Android, Kotlin, Firebase SDK)
- [x] Cloud Functions — `functions/` (TypeScript, Firebase Functions v7)
- [ ] Admin Scripts — `scripts/`
- [x] Docs only — `docs/`

**Firebase RTDB impact**: Hard-replace V1 schema with V2 schema (`/devices/{id}/`).

**RS-485 protocol impact**: No change.

**Hardware required for full validation**: Yes — ESP32 for BLE provisioning testing.

**Performance / timing constraints**: BLE Provisioning completion < 30s. Device Shadow round-trip < 5s.

## Execution Phases

See [tasks.md](tasks.md) for the detailed step-by-step implementation tasks. The execution is split into:
1. Setup (`.gitignore`, templates)
2. Foundational (Database Rules deployment)
3. US1 Provisioning (BLE + Firmware + Android)
4. US2 Device Control (Shadow Round-Trip)
5. US3 Security Validation
6. US4 Observability
7. Factory Reset (BLE Char + Cloud Function)
8. Cloud Functions V2 Compatibility
9. Developer Guide Documentation
